items.t: CVS Pharmacy® names Grand Prize winners of first Home Team Heroes youth soccer contest
items.sum: CVS Pharmacy®, the retail division of CVS Health® (NYSE: CVS), and its Well Market® store brand consumables line today named Caroline, age 9, of Holmes Beach, Florida, and Zoe, age 12, of Los Angeles, California, the Grand Prize winners of the first CVS Home Team Heroes soccer contest. The nationwide contest recognizes young soccer players making a meaningful difference in their communities.

items.t: CVS Health Raised Its 2026 Outlook 3 Times, but Not Its Dividend
items.sum: CVS has the cash, the earnings momentum, and a recovering Aetna, yet shareholders have collected the same payout for 12 straight quarters. Management has other priorities first, and a planned breakup could complicate the answer.

items.t: CVS Health (CVS) Plans Two Company Breakup
items.sum: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) plans to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies focused on healthcare services and retail pharmacy. The board has approved the breakup plan, with management outlining a multiyear transition to complete the separation.
